usedFor: ikas holds store orders and Documint builds documents from templates, so “New Order” can run “Add Content To Template”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in ikas, then “Add Content To Template” in Documint
bestTemplate.why: Each new ikas order feeds its details into a Documint template instead of being typed in.

watchOut: “Order Updated” in ikas can also run “Add Content To Template”, so one order may be added more than once.
